resources.string: One Hand Control uses the Accessibility Service to show edge gesture zones, read screen/window state needed for configured actions, and perform user-chosen actions such as Back, Home, system-setting toggles, screenshots, app launch, touch pad, and macros. Connectivity toggles briefly identify and press the matching control in Android Settings. No Accessibility data is collected or shared.

One Hand Control needs Accessibility access to show edge gesture zones, read screen/window state needed for the actions you choose, and perform those actions, such as Back, Home, connectivity toggles, screenshots, scrolling, app launch, touch pad, and macros. When you trigger a connectivity toggle, the app briefly opens Android Settings, identifies and presses only the matching switch, then returns.
Accessibility access is used only on your device for your configured gestures and actions. The app does not collect, transmit, sell, or share Accessibility data.
